Name: VC's Raven Pet
Author: VampireCowboi
Description:
Do you want to walk outside every morning and constantly wonder why your scarecrows aren't working?
[size=2] ﻿Or maybe you think Stardew Valley is lacking in murders?[/size][size=1]
﻿ ﻿... Or you just wish you had a crow friend of your very own? [/size][size=3]

You're in luck! I've got just the mod for you.[/size]

Adds a raven as a pet! It is a standalone pet type, so it doesn't replace any of the starter cats or dogs, and you can also adopt it later on from Marnie if you like.
Complete with "caw" noises. :)
And no, they will not eat your crops.[size=2] Even if it's very tempting.[/size] This raven is very well behaved[size=1].[/size]

[b][u]CHANGELOG:
[/u][/b]04/21/24 - 2.0.2
[list]
[*]Hotfix to remove a stray config file & make Hats on Pets an optional dependency.

[/list]04/21/24 -- 2.0.1
[list]
[*]Hotfix to add hat support for Ravens made with the 1.0.0 version.
[/list]04/21/24 -- 2.0.0
[list]
[*][b]Customization Options[/b]: 4 body colors & 9 eye colors. You can mix-match to create 3 different looking ravens that you can adopt.
[*][b]Hat Support[/b]: Unfortunately due to their head shape it isn't possible for all hats to look amazing. Better than no hats though!
[*][b]Custom Gifts[/b]: Now will give you custom gifts! Look below in the spoiler tag if you want to see exactly what they will give you.
[*][b]Bugfixes:[/b] Fixed some behavior logic & the adoption event animations.
[/list]
[b][u]GIFTS:
[/u][/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]3 Hearts: Random selection of trash (broken glasses, broken CD, broken branch, etc.)
[*]4 Hearts: A couple of copper or iron ores.
[*]Max Hearts: A chance to get a cheap ring. (glow ring, magnet ring, etc.)
[*]Max Hearts: A small chance to get some bone artifacts.
[*]Max Hearts: A chance to get one gold ore.
[*]Max Hearts: A rare chance to get a gem. (ruby, emerald, topaz, etc.)
[*]Max Hearts: A VERY small chance to get an iridium ore.
[/list][/spoiler][b][u]REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Will only work with Stardew 1.6.
[/list][list]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631]Hats on Pets Plus[/url]﻿ if you would like to put hats on your raven!

[*]To install, unzip the file and place into your Stardew/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game once to generate the config file. I recommend using[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098] Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change configs in game.
[*]A Color Reference is in the mod folder for your convenience. :)
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
[b][u]SPECIAL THANKS
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Thank you Syma for Hats on Pets Plus! ^ ^ Our beloved birds wouldn't be able to wear hats without them, so be sure to endorse their mod if you like the feature!

[/list]
